'''Karedda''' was the third and outermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="JAS" /><ref name="HS" /><ref name="GOW" /><ref name="EA" /> [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the blue-white [[Star/Legends|star]]<ref name="JAS" /> [[Kessa/Legends|Kessa]] in the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessa system]],<ref name="JAS" /><ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="GOW" /><ref name="EAOC" /> Karedda had no [[Moon/Legends|moons]], being an [[Water/Legends|Ice]] ball-type planet.<ref name="HS" /><ref name="GOW" /><ref name="EA" />

By the [[Post-Imperial era|New Republic Era]],<ref name="Date">The timeline provided in ''[[Star Wars: Beware the Sith]]'' establishes that the [[Post-Imperial era|New Republic Era]] started in [[4 ABY/Legends |4 ABY]] and lasted until at least [[20 ABY/Legends|20 ABY]].</ref> it was established that the entire [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was doomed to extinction. The [[Maw Cluster/Legends|Maw Cluster]], a conglomeration of [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]] and [[Nebula/Legends|gas clouds]], crept nearer and nearer to the system every [[Standard century/Legends|century]], and [[Astronomer/Legends|astronomers]] predicted that the Maw would tear apart and consume the Kessel system within a [[Millennium/Legends|thousand]] years or so. Karedda was located far removed from its brother planets, maintaining an orbit in the system's furthermost regions. Karedda was already showing signs of reacting to the Maw's [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational forces]]; over the past few centuries, its orbit had developed a slight wobble when the planet passed closest to the Maw.<ref name="JAS" />

Powerful and lethal [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] poured from the Maw, making spacewalks in all but the most heavily shielded [[Environment suit/Legends|vaccsuits]] deadly and rendering life on the planets of the Kessel system unlivable without advanced technological [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]].<ref name="JAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessa system]], except [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], were first introduced in the [[1996]] roleplaying guide ''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]'', published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="JAS" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Kessa star system in grid square T-10.<ref name="EA" />
